title: Waterfall Giant

moves.title: Pressure Gun
effects: Deal 23+ damage, increases by 5 each use

moves.title: About to Blow
effects: Capture pressure value for final explosion

moves.title: Explode
effects: Deal damage equal to accumulated Steam Eruption power

move_pattern: Starts with Pressurize. Then cycles through Stomp → Ram → Siphon → Pressure Gun → Pressure Up, repeating from Stomp. When pressure builds up to 6 stacks, monster transitions to About to Blow (stuns the player) followed by Explode (final damage attack). Siphon is hidden from the bestiary.
notes: Waterfall Giant's core mechanic revolves around Steam Eruption power buildup. Each regular move applies Steam Eruption stacks (3 per move, except Pressurize which applies 20 initially). The SteamEruptionPower power tracks accumulated pressure that determines the final explosion damage. After 6 buildup increments, the monster enters About to Blow phase, stuns the player, and then deals massive damage based on the total accumulated pressure. Pressure Gun is unique in that it increases damage by 5 each time it's used. Siphon heals the monster for 15 HP per player in combat and is not shown in the bestiary.
